name: smwmusic-super-mario-world-water-empty-town-style
title: Super Mario World - Water (Empty Town style)
description:
This remix is based on Retro Gaming's Siivagunner remix of Super Mario World's water theme done in the style of Empty Town from Deltarune.

It can be used underwater, or it can be used in a town, or it can be used in an empty place.
